description:
THREE IDENTITIES IN ONE PAINTING.
Keep Spell I, Spell II, and Spell III as distinct identities — each stays itself (subject, form, palette). They share one scene and interact. Not a triptych, not a 3-panel collage, not one mashed hybrid that erases any identity.
Studio author: Logan Sevin.

MANDATORY PRODUCT PALETTE (override all source colors): Silver (#C0C0C0); Ash (#B2BEB5); Apricot (#FBCEB1); Coffee (#6F4E37). Paint with these hex pigments as dominant hues.

THE THREE IDENTITIES (keep each one recognizable):
SPELL I — Silver and Ash Terminal with apricot tex… (#400037)
Silver and Ash Terminal with apricot text and a clear coffee monitor.

SPELL II — Dog using paper computer (#400038)
Dog using paper computer

FUSION: one canvas, three identities still countable. Spell I remains Spell I
